title: vl03 subsection Operatoren (deferred to Lecture 4): 'einen Hilbertraum', 'Das heisst', 'operatoren', word order
reason: Wording only, in the subsection Operatoren of vl03 (lines 253-277), which is not migrated with Lecture 3: it opens the material of vl04 and is migrated with Lecture 4 (vl03-map.json, status deferred). 'einen Hilbertraum' after 'Sei' needs the nominative 'ein'; 'heisst' is 'heißt'; the noun 'Operatoren' is capitalised; in the subordinate clause the verb goes last ('dass die Dimension ... n = 2 beträgt'). The English edition (lec03.tex:256, 260, 271) has none of these slips. The new_text is a proposal for the Lecture 4 migration. Corrected after evidence/derivations/c03/REVIEW-lec3.md, section C (M-0024): the earlier new_text 'betrage $n = 2$' still put the verb before its complement; old_text now includes 'dass' so that the new_text is the whole subordinate clause with the verb last.
